services.title: Super express (<6h)
services.desc: Under 6 hours – ideal for documents, files and papers that are extremely urgent.
services.points:
Pickup in 30–60 minutes
Priority for urgent documents
services.detail:
Super express is Swift247's fastest service, delivering within 6 hours of pickup. It is ideal for documents, tender files, contracts, legal papers or small parcels that must arrive the same day.
A courier collects your item within 30–60 minutes, the order is handled with priority and goes straight to the recipient with minimal transfers. Track the journey in real time in the app and get notified as soon as it is delivered.

services.title: Express (<24h)
services.desc: Delivered within 24 hours – ideal for goods and documents that must arrive by the next day.
services.detail:
Express balances speed and cost: goods and documents are delivered within 24 hours, reaching the recipient the next day nationwide.
Orders are picked up at your door, packed and moved through Swift247's fast delivery network and partners, with status updates in the app and on the tracking page.

services.title: Economy express (24-48h)
services.desc: Delivered within 24-48 hours at the best rate, for goods that are not too urgent.
services.points:
Lowest rates
Ideal for bulk shipments
services.detail:
Economy express delivers in 24–48 hours at the best rate, for goods that are not urgent, bulk orders or regular shipments.
It still includes door-to-door pickup, cash on delivery (COD) and transparent reconciliation, helping shops and businesses save on shipping while keeping delivery times reliable.

services.title: Business agents
services.desc: Delivery solutions for shops and businesses: volume-based rates and clear debt reconciliation.
services.detail:
The Business agent programme is for shops, online sellers and companies that ship regularly. Rates are based on volume – the more you ship, the more you save.
Swift247 provides a dedicated order management account, clear monthly reconciliation, a personal account manager and API integration. Leave your details for a tailored consultation.

modes.title: Door to Door
modes.text: Pick-up at home, delivered to the door.
modes.detail: A courier collects from your door and hands the parcel directly to the recipient – no trip to a post office.
modes.points:
Best for: urgent parcels, documents, busy customers
Pick-up within 30–60 minutes in city areas
Live courier tracking

modes.title: Door to Point
modes.text: Pick-up at home, collect at a post office.
modes.detail: A courier collects from your door; the recipient picks the parcel up at the nearest post office.
modes.points:
Best for: recipients who are often out or want to choose a time
Cheaper than door delivery
Held free at the post office for up to 3 days

modes.title: Point to Point
modes.text: Drop at a post office, collect at a post office.
modes.detail: Drop the parcel at a post office; the recipient collects it at the destination office.
modes.points:
Best for: shops sending in bulk, non-urgent parcels
The lowest price of the four options
Packing and weighing at the counter

modes.title: Point to Door
modes.text: Drop at a post office, delivered to the door.
modes.detail: Drop the parcel at a post office and Swift247 delivers it to the recipient's door.
modes.points:
Best for: gifts, sending on your way past an office
No waiting for a pick-up
Hand delivery with cash-on-delivery support
